comments.author: @robjef622
comments.text: This is one of those movies that leaves you feeling grim and depressed for the rest of your day after you finish watching it. You'll think to yourself "how could anyone possibly make a movie so cruel and harrowing?" It is admittedly very good and extremely well-acted, but I just can't recommend it due to how soul-crushing it is. If you really are so curious, then watch it, but I would strongly advise you to watch something else entirely. It's not just dark, it's pitch black.
